feature_groups.Order Intake: Shipday delivery data, order CSV upload, feedback sync
feature_groups.SMS: Telnyx inbound collection, outbound dispatch queue
feature_groups.Broadcast: Mass SMS + email broadcast dispatch and form intake
feature_groups.Email Campaigns: Instantly campaign management, performance tracking, lead seeding
feature_groups.Intelligence: Contact Sweep (hourly rule-based loop), AI Stack (Claude observer→advisor→orchestrator), Stage Runner, Lapsed Re-engagement
feature_groups.Field Agent: Field sales outcome sync from Airtable, daily brief
feature_groups.Agent Rules: Agent playbook sync from Airtable to Postgres
feature_groups.Growth: Competitor research, goal agent experiments, weekly growth agent
feature_groups.Reports: Daily activity and outcome email reports
feature_groups.Chatbot: Google Docs sync, chatbot reindex, query form

admin_secret.note: Single bootstrap credential stored in n8n. Used by all workflows to call GET /api/credentials at runtime. ADMIN_SECRET env var must be set in Render.

airtable.note: API key stored in .env as AIRTABLE_API_KEY. Workflows fetch this at runtime via GET /api/credentials.

telnyx.note: API key stored in .env as TELNYX_API_KEY. Workflows fetch this at runtime via GET /api/credentials.

google.note: Google OAuth credentials stored in n8n credential store (Google Drive + Google Docs). Future: migrate to service account via /api/internal/drive/upload.

smtp.note: Gmail SMTP. Future: migrate to POST /api/internal/send-email so no SMTP credential needed in n8n.

google_drive.note: Google Drive OAuth2. Future: migrate to POST /api/internal/drive/upload.

google_docs.note: Google Docs OAuth2. Used by [Chatbot] Docs Sync to read document content.

n8n.note: API key stored in .env as N8N_API_KEY

shipday_delivery_collector.name: [Order Intake] Order Collector
shipday_delivery_collector.note: Fetches orders from Shipday API and POSTs to POST /api/shipday/ingest-orders.

shipday_feedback_sync.name: [Order Intake] Feedback Sync
shipday_feedback_sync.note: Polls Shipday API for customer feedback, delivery instructions, proof-of-delivery.

shipday_historical_import.name: [Order Intake] Historical Import
shipday_historical_import.note: One-shot backfill: imports up to 1 year of Shipday order history. Run once to seed DB.

telnyx_inbound_collector.name: [SMS] Inbound Collector
telnyx_inbound_collector.note: Polls Telnyx MDR endpoint for inbound SMS records. Also receives real-time webhooks via POST /api/webhooks/telnyx.

sms_dispatch.name: [SMS] Dispatch Queue
sms_dispatch.note: Polls action_queue for send_sms actions and dispatches via Telnyx API.

telnyx_sms_historical_import.name: [SMS] Historical Import
telnyx_sms_historical_import.note: One-shot backfill of inbound SMS from Telnyx MDR API.

broadcast_dispatch.name: [Broadcast] Dispatch
broadcast_dispatch.note: Polls broadcast_recipients table and dispatches SMS (Telnyx) + email (SMTP).

campaign_performance_tracker.name: [Email Campaigns] Performance Tracker
campaign_performance_tracker.note: Fetches analytics per campaign from Instantly API, stores stats in DB.

instantly_campaign_sync.name: [Email Campaigns] Campaign Sync
instantly_campaign_sync.note: Fetches Instantly campaigns tagged 'dabbahwala' and POSTs to POST /api/webhooks/sync-campaigns.

instantly_bulk_seed.name: [Email Campaigns] Bulk Seed
instantly_bulk_seed.note: One-shot manual workflow: seeds ALL active contacts into their Instantly campaigns.

instantly_setup.name: [Email Campaigns] Campaign Setup
instantly_setup.note: No-op if all campaigns already exist. Sets up missing campaigns in Instantly.

hourly_intelligence_cycle.name: [Intelligence] Contact Sweep
hourly_intelligence_cycle.note: Hourly rule-based loop: COLLECT→PROFILE→SIGNAL→ROUTE→DISPATCH. No Claude calls.

lifecycle_cycle_cron.name: [Intelligence] Stage Runner
lifecycle_cycle_cron.note: Stage Engine: pure SQL rules that move contacts between lifecycle stages.

lapsed_customer_cycle.name: [Intelligence] Lapsed Re-engagement
lapsed_customer_cycle.note: Persistent re-engagement cycle for lapsed contacts.

airtable_outcome_sync.name: [Field Agent] Outcome Sync
airtable_outcome_sync.note: Pulls call outcomes from Airtable Field Sales Tasks and writes back to contacts.

daily_field_brief.name: [Field Agent] Daily Brief
daily_field_brief.note: Creates field_sales_call opportunities, writes to Airtable Field Sales Tasks, emails summary to core@dabbahwala.com at 7:30 AM.

airtable_playbook_sync.name: [Agent Rules] Playbook Sync
airtable_playbook_sync.note: Syncs agent_playbook rules from Airtable → Postgres daily at 6 AM.

airtable_menu_sync.name: [Menu] Catalog Sync
airtable_menu_sync.note: Pulls all records from Airtable 'Menu Catalog', upserts into menu_catalog in Postgres, detects deletions.

competitor_agent_cycle.name: [Growth] Competitor Research
competitor_agent_cycle.note: Weekly: parse competitor samples, scrape live sites, Claude generates hypotheses, auto-injects into goal_experiments.

goal_agent_cycle.name: [Growth] Goal Agent
goal_agent_cycle.note: 4-phase proactive experiment loop: HYPOTHESIZE → EXPERIMENT → MEASURE → HARVEST.

growth_agent_cycle.name: [Growth] Weekly Growth Agent
growth_agent_cycle.note: Weekly: refresh baseline conv rate, measure experiments, Claude designs new experiment, emails growth report.

daily_activity_report.name: [Reports] Daily Activity Report
daily_activity_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/activity → Claude writes HTML + CSV → emails to REPORT_EMAIL_TO.

daily_outcome_report.name: [Reports] Daily Outcome Report
daily_outcome_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/outcome → Claude writes HTML + CSV → emails to REPORT_EMAIL_TO.

google_docs_sync.name: [Chatbot] Docs Sync
google_docs_sync.note: Reads Google Docs from Drive folder and pushes content to chatbot index.

action_queue_executor.name: [System] Action Queue
action_queue_executor.note: Central action hub. Routes pending action_queue rows to: Airtable, Instantly, Google Drive, SMTP, Telnyx.

system_connectivity_check.name: [System] Connectivity Check
system_connectivity_check.note: 6 independent nodes — one per service. Each shows green/red in n8n execution view.

system_feature_tests.name: [System] Feature Tests
system_feature_tests.note: 11 parallel nodes — one per test group (G1, G2, G3, G5, G7-G9, G11-G14). Each shows green/red independently.

google_docs.note: Set up Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials in n8n. Folder ID is hardcoded in workflow.

classification.ad_copy: Title contains: ad copy, social media, facebook, instagram, social post
classification.ground_note: Title contains: field note, ground, delivery note, driver (or default)
